item.title: Cloud service player authentication dialog issue fixed - Caster.fm
item.description: For the past two days there was an issue with the Caster.fm Cloud service stream player in which listeners would get an authentication dialog when they try to play the stream. We’ve detected the cause of the issue, and it has now been solved.

item.title: Free Plan and Free Cloud Network Outage - Caster.fm
item.description: We are aware of a service outage for our free plan and free cloud services.We are currently investigating the network outage and working to bring the service up as soon as possible.We will post further updates as soon as we’ll conclude the investigation. Thank you for your understanding.

item.title: Free Plan and Free Cloud Network Restored - Caster.fm
item.description: We’ve detected the cause of the outage; it has now been fixed.Our free plan and free cloud services are now back online. We thank you for your patience and understanding. Caster.fm
